seoTitle: Add a Payment Gateway to Your Hostinger Website
metaDescription: Connect Stripe, PayPal, or another payment provider to your Hostinger store so you can start accepting online payments.
intro: Setting up a payment gateway is essential if you're planning to sell products or services through a Hostinger website. This guide covers navigating to your store's payment settings and connecting a provider like Stripe or PayPal.

steps.heading: Log in to Hostinger
steps.body: Go to hostinger.com and click Log In, entering your credentials to reach your hPanel dashboard.

steps.heading: Open your store
steps.body: From the sidebar, click Websites, find the site you want to configure, and click Manage Store to enter the store management area.

steps.heading: Go to Payments in Settings
steps.body: Inside the store panel, click Settings, then scroll to the Payments section where you handle all transaction-related configuration.

steps.heading: Add a payment provider
steps.body: Click the + Add button to see supported providers like Stripe and PayPal, depending on your region and setup.

steps.heading: Complete the integration
steps.body: Follow the on-screen prompts to input credentials or API keys for your chosen provider, then confirm the setup is complete.

faq.question: Which payment gateways does Hostinger support?
faq.answer: Common options include Stripe and PayPal, with availability depending on your region and store setup.

faq.question: Do I need to know how to code to connect a payment gateway?
faq.answer: No, Hostinger guides you through the API connection process with on-screen instructions.

faq.question: Should I test the checkout after adding a payment gateway?
faq.answer: Yes, testing the checkout process once setup is complete helps confirm everything runs smoothly before customers use it.

faq.question: Can I add more than one payment method?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add multiple providers so customers have a choice of payment options at checkout.
